file_list_assertion: Both accession-scoped RAW files appear exactly once; no blank RAW deposited.
biological_evidence: PRIDE project description states two enamel protein extractions from a single Late Pleistocene tooth fragment from Nam Lot, Laos, identified as genus Pongo. PRIDE structured organism is Pongo sp. (NEWT:9603), organism part tooth enamel (BTO:0001844). Extraction identifiers 1307 and 1438 are taken literally from file names; biological replicate 1 marks the single specimen.
technical_evidence: PRIDE sample protocol explicitly states no proteolysis with a protease, Q Exactive HF-X top-10 DDA, 350-1400 m/z, HCD 28 NCE, 1.2 m/z isolation width. Thus cleavage agent not applicable.
limitations: Sex, age at death, and disease unknown. The two extraction codes are not asserted as independent biological samples.
